story.title: Everyday objects.
story.bowl: A handcrafted, heart-shaped cement bowl for the rings, keys, coins and little keepsakes that matter. Each piece is individually made, so no two are ever exactly alike.
story.chess: Solid hardwood and sixteen hand-finished pieces, frozen mid-game. Every piece is a hook for the keys, headphones and jacket you carry in and out.
story.stop: Crafted from an original stop sign in aluminium. A limited-edition piece that reflects light and attitude in equal measure.
